items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) : ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: MvPolynomial.le_degreeOf_of_mem_support
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (i : σ) {s : σ →₀ ℕ} : s ∈ p.support → s i ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p

items.name: MvPolynomial.monomial_le_degreeOf
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (i : σ) {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {m : σ →₀ ℕ} (h_m : m ∈ f.support) : m i ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {n : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ} : MvPolynomial.degreeOf n f ≤ d ↔ ∀ m ∈ f.support, m n ≤ d

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_sub_lt
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {x : σ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} {k : ℕ} (h : 0 < k) (hf : ∀ m ∈ f.support, k ≤ m x → f.coeff m = g.coeff m) (hg : ∀ m ∈ g.support, k ≤ m x → f.coeff m = g.coeff m) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf x (f - g) < k
